shortDescription: Manage Ruby Gem dependencies with Bundler

options.name: binstub_directory
options.description: Only applies if O(state=present). Specifies the directory to install any gem bins files to. When executed the bin files run within the context of the Gemfile and fail if any required gem dependencies are not installed. If O(chdir) is set then this path is relative to O(chdir).

options.name: chdir
options.description: The directory to execute the bundler commands from. This directory needs to contain a valid Gemfile or .bundle/ directory. If not specified, it defaults to the temporary working directory.

options.name: clean
options.description: Only applies if O(state=present). If set removes any gems on the target host that are not in the gemfile.

options.name: deployment_mode
options.description: Only applies if O(state=present). If set it installs gems in C(./vendor/bundle) instead of the default location. Requires a C(Gemfile.lock) file to have been created prior.

options.name: exclude_groups
options.description: A list of Gemfile groups to exclude during operations. This only applies when O(state=present). Bundler considers this a 'remembered' property for the Gemfile and automatically excludes groups in future operations even if O(exclude_groups) is not set.

options.name: executable
options.description: The path to the bundler executable.

options.name: extra_args
options.description: A space separated string of additional commands that can be applied to the Bundler command. Refer to the Bundler documentation for more information.

options.name: gem_path
options.description: Only applies if O(state=present). Specifies the directory to install the gems into. If O(chdir) is set then this path is relative to O(chdir). If not specified the default RubyGems gem paths are used.

options.name: gemfile
options.description: Only applies if O(state=present). The path to the gemfile to use to install gems. If not specified it defaults to the Gemfile in current directory.

options.name: local
options.description: If set only installs gems from the cache on the target host.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the Gem bundle. V(latest) updates gems to the most recent, acceptable version.

options.name: user_install
options.description: Only applies if O(state=present). Installs gems in the local user's cache or for all users.
